summary: Destroys a node and its owned data struct. Guarded by the node's flag byte at +8: if set and the node's data pointer at +0 is non-null, resets the data struct via SessionConfigDefaultInit, frees three optional internal pointer fields (at +0, +8, +0x14) and then frees the data struct itself. Returns the flag byte value.

operations.description: Read the node flag byte at this+8 into the result value.
If the flag byte is zero, return it immediately without touching the data struct.
Load the node's data struct pointer from this+0.
If the data struct pointer is null, return the flag value without performing deletion.
Reset the data struct to default state via SessionConfigDefaultInit.
If the data struct pointer field at +0x14 (v2[5]) is non-null, free it.
Free the data struct pointer field at +0x14 via FreeWrapper_7bcf.
If the data struct pointer field at +8 (v2[2]) is non-null, free it.
Free the data struct pointer field at +8 via FreeWrapper_7bcf.
If the data struct pointer field at +0 (v2[0]) is non-null, free it.
Free the data struct pointer field at +0 via FreeWrapper_7bcf.
Free the data struct itself via FreeWrapper_7bcf and return the flag value.

unresolved: Node and data struct types are unknown; the three data struct pointer fields at +0, +8 and +0x14 are opaque.
